newsitem.title: USA: Millennium names new inorganic chief.
newsitem.headline: Millennium names new inorganic chief.

text.p: Millennium Chemicals Inc said Wednesday Robert E. Lee has been named president and chief executive officer of its Millennium Inorganic Chemicals subsidiary.
He replaces Donald V. Borst, who is retiring.
Lee has been president and chief operating officer of Millennium Chemicals, and will continue as a director of Millennium Chemicals Inc and vice chairman of its Operations Committee.
Lee's position and its responsibilities will be added to the duties of William M. Landuyt, chairman and chief executive officer. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
